rows.reasoning: Nass voted Aye (18-15) on Senate concurrence for single-subject AB 103 (2025), whose operative section bars staff from using a name or pronouns not aligned with biological sex "without written authorization from the pupil’s parent or legal guardian" — the rung "Require parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns." His cosponsorships and votes on the multi-part parental bills of rights AB 963 and AB 510 point the same way but are multi-subject and carry no chair on their own.
